name: Hulk's Thunderclap
oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may behold a Gamma creature. (You may choose a Gamma creature you control or reveal a Gamma creature card from your hand.)
Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to another target creature. If this spell's additional cost was paid, destroy target noncreature artifact or noncreature enchantment.
blocked_sentences: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to another target creature. If this spell's additional cost was paid, destroy target noncreature artifact or noncreature enchantment.

needs.what: a target spec declared only when the spell's optional additional cost is paid (the additional-cost twin of `count_if_kicked`): 'If this spell's additional cost was paid, destroy target noncreature artifact or noncreature enchantment'
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `count_if_kicked` keys the extra target on kicker alone; the behold cost is `additional_cost` with `additional_optional`, read by `additional_paid` at resolution, which is after targets are declared (601.2c). Declaring the target unconditionally makes an unpaid cast need, and possibly lack, a third target
